author: 03 Research synthetic fixture
statement: In the fictional Example Ball League, selections with the preregistered public-signal score at or above 0.60 and offered decimal odds at or above 2.00 produce positive net return after a fixed 0.02-unit execution cost per 1.00-unit stake.
rationale: The fictional signal is constructed to demonstrate the EdgeLab research path; it is not evidence about any real sport, source, market, or strategy.
population: The twelve pre-enumerated fictional events in retained H-M0-183 synthetic evidence; no external population is implied.
required_data: synthetic signal value and publication time
synthetic offered and opposing decimal prices and observation time
synthetic decision, event, and outcome-availability times
entry_conditions: Select once per enumerated event when signal >= 0.60, offered decimal odds >= 2.00, and both signal and price are available no later than the decision timestamp.
information_cutoff: Only signal and price observations timestamped at or before each decision may select an event; outcomes must become available strictly after the event.
price_requirements: Offered decimal odds >= 2.00; record the opposing side's decimal odds to measure two-way market overround.
sizing_assumptions: A fixed fictional 1.00-unit stake per selected event; no compounding, bankroll sizing, or capital allocation.
cost_model: Deduct a fixed fictional 0.02 unit from every selected event in addition to the offered decimal-price payoff.
evaluation_metrics: net profit and ROI after cost
95 percent Wilson interval for win rate
minimum_sample_expectations: At least 20 eligible independent fictional events are required for a sufficient synthetic confirmatory result.
rejection_criteria: fewer than 20 eligible events yields INSUFFICIENT_DATA
any decision input available after its decision timestamp invalidates the affected evidence
duplicate event identity or missing required evidence invalidates the experiment
a 95 percent Wilson interval containing the cost-adjusted break-even rate cannot demonstrate edge
failure of the future-leakage negative control invalidates the evaluator
validation_procedure: Evaluate the one frozen retained dataset exactly once with deterministic Decimal arithmetic, reject temporal leakage before calculating metrics, run the isolated future-leakage negative control, and preserve the full result.
multiple_testing_plan: One hypothesis, one fixed selection rule, one fixed dataset, and no parameter search or post-result modification.
